messages.feed.help.title: Feed
messages.feed.help.what: Collects updates from RSS, web search, email, or code repositories in one stream so you can save what matters to Materials, Inbox, or Goals.
messages.feed.help.example-1: Add an RSS feed or search topic to scan fresh updates in one place
messages.feed.help.example-2: Save a useful item to project materials, send it to Inbox, or turn it into a goal
messages.feed.help.scope: Fetching sources contacts only the URLs or connected accounts you added; Feed never posts or replies on your behalf, and removing a source keeps saved items.
messages.feed.help.advanced: Repeated syncs skip duplicates automatically; bind a published judgment rule when you want automatic triage.

messages.feed.actions.rules-delete.title: Delete capture rule

messages.feed.actions.rules-preview.title: Preview keyword matches

messages.feed.actions.items-offers.title: Available Feed actions
messages.feed.actions.items-offers.description: Prepares ready-to-run options for the current Feed item without making changes.
messages.feed.actions.items-read.title: Mark as read
messages.feed.actions.items-read.description: Marks a Feed item as read without changing whether it’s saved or ignored.
messages.feed.actions.items-inbox.title: Add to Inbox
messages.feed.actions.items-inbox.description: Adds the item to Inbox against the version you read and runs the active Inbox next-step rule.
messages.feed.actions.items-disposition.title: Save or archive item
messages.feed.actions.items-disposition.descripti: Marks a Feed item as saved for reference or archived against the version you read.

messages.feed.actions.items-restore.description: Returns an archived or handled item back to the Feed list.

messages.feed.actions.sources-add-account.title: Add account source
messages.feed.actions.sources-add-account.descrip: Adds an account source for a supported service such as GitHub, Gmail, Notion, or Linear. Pick an account in source settings before fetching.
messages.feed.actions.sources-update.title: Update source
messages.feed.actions.sources-update.description: Updates a source’s name, description, filter scope, or feed address.
messages.feed.actions.sources-delete.title: Delete source

messages.feed.actions.sources-schedule.descriptio: Sets a source to manual fetch only or automatic fetching on a fixed interval.

messages.feed.actions.sources-sync.title: Fetch now
messages.feed.actions.sources-sync.description: Fetches new items from a source right away and applies active capture rules. Retrying the same request won’t duplicate fetches.
messages.feed.actions.sources-tick.title: Fetch due sources
messages.feed.actions.sources-tick.description: Fetches enabled sources whose schedule is due and updates their next fetch time.
messages.feed.actions.items-admission.title: Check Inbox eligibility
messages.feed.actions.items-admission.description: Checks whether a Feed item can be added or returned to Inbox. Archived items must be restored first.
messages.feed.actions.items-material.title: Read item material
messages.feed.actions.items-material.description: Reads the current full text of an active, non-archived item from a valid source for drafting or organizing.
messages.feed.actions.items-content.title: Read item content
messages.feed.actions.items-content.description: Reads an item’s title, summary, body, and saved text so Inbox can suggest the next step.
messages.feed.actions.briefs-read.title: Read item and source briefs
messages.feed.actions.briefs-read.description: Reads titles, source names, and summaries by ID for display labels without loading full bodies.
messages.feed.actions.items-admit.title: Admit item to Inbox
messages.feed.actions.items-admit.description: Adds a Feed item to Inbox (reopening it if already handled) and runs the active next-step rule.
messages.feed.actions.notifications-receive.title: Receive plugin notifications
messages.feed.actions.notifications-receive.descr: Receives plugin notifications into the Plugin notifications source and runs active rules, keeping the message even if evaluation fails.
messages.feed.actions.subject-read.title: Read Feed item and links
messages.feed.actions.subject-read.description: Reads a Feed item’s current text, version, and links for accurate reference.
messages.feed.actions.source-subject-read.title: Read source status and links
messages.feed.actions.source-subject-read.descrip: Reads a Feed source’s current status, version, and links for accurate reference.

messages.feed.actions.sources-wake.title: Wake due source fetches

messages.feed.actions.demo-seed.title: Seed demo Feed items
messages.feed.actions.demo-seed.description: Populates sample sources and items for a demo project, leaving already initialized projects untouched.

messages.feed.actions.presentation-values.title: Feed display fields
messages.feed.actions.presentation-values.descrip: Reads display fields for the requested Feed items within your current access, marking unavailable or deleted items without modifying data.
messages.feed.actions.presentation-overview.title: Feed home overview
messages.feed.actions.presentation-overview.descr: Reads a brief Feed overview, top items, and quick entry points. Read-only and doesn’t call a model.
messages.feed.actions.content-hold.title: Track retained item text
messages.feed.actions.content-hold.description: Records which locally saved message bodies a project source references before writing them.

messages.feed.actions.content-release.description: Releases a deleted source’s references to saved text and removes bodies no longer referenced anywhere.

messages.feed.actions.content-reclaim.description: Reclaims orphaned text references after a failed, canceled, or interrupted fetch and cleans up unreferenced bodies.
